notes: All servo drives are Kollmorgen SERVOSTAR 600 family (S403/S443, firmware V7.20, hardware 08.03) on CAN bus 1 of the Cnc886 control (CBAUD 1000 kbit/s). 'M' = master variant with CANopen, 'A' = slave/basic variant. Drive X3 connector carries the digital inputs (PSTOP, NSTOP, DI1 reference), DOUT1/2 and ENABLE; X2 = resolver, X5 = encoder emulation/input, X6 = power to motor, X4 = brake, X0/X1 = CAN in/out, X7 = 24 V logic supply, X8 = mains L1 L2 L3.

The AMC parameter dumps were taken from the drives (file names 'Amplifier X' etc.). Drive CAN addresses: X=8, Y1=7, Y2=6, Z=5, A=18, B=17. Running hours (TRUN) at dump time: X 18770 h, Y1 18874 h, Y2 3710 h (replaced drive), Z 22763 h, A 18764 h, B 18828 h.

A1/B1 drives report 'Drive 403 @ 300 V' (DC bus for 1 x 230 V supply, VBUSBAL 0) while X/Y1/Y2/Z report '@ 600 V' (3 x 400 V supply). On sheet 27 the A1 drive mains terminals are labelled L1, L2, L3/N.

Gearing: X master (GEARMODE 6) and Y1/Y2 follow the same parameter set except DIR and GP. Y1/Y2 are the two sides of the gantry (Y1 master side carries the limit switches, Y2 only a reference switch).
Motion task table (ORDER 1-3 and 192-194) is identical in all drives: homing/jog tasks used by the control.
